_comment: Exercises wintty.c render_status() (4991-5262) and its rest-of-row erase (5251-5256) with statuslines:3, weaponstatus, armorstatus and terrainstatus while conditions come and go: a wished ring of levitation adds Lev when put on and drops it when removed, and a blindfold does the same for Blind, with corner and full-screen menus between.
